title: Xanthe and the Clock
author: Lena Nakamura
blurb: Wren Ashgrove, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
